en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a European riverside town. In the foreground a river curves past a multi‑arch stone bridge with an additional flat, more modern span alongside it. On the near bank are grassy meadows; on the far bank stand dense rows of traditional gabled houses and small industrial buildings. A large church with a tall spire dominates the right side of the skyline, while a twin‑towered church or abbey rises on the left. Bare tree branches frame the scene, suggesting it was photographed in late autumn or winter. There is no visible caption or printed text on the image side.
